en: A black‑and‑white postcard image showing a wide landscape with numerous conical teepees arranged in a large encampment, likely an Indigenous North American camp. Horses graze and stand tethered throughout the open field, and people can be seen walking and gathering among the tents. Trees form a dense line behind the camp, with low hills and a cloudy sky in the distance. The photograph has an aged, slightly scratched appearance. Faint, inverted handwriting or numbering appears along the top edge.
